comparisonHint: Differences are selected day minus comparison day. Distance and speed retain unconfirmed source units, without physical conversion. Percentages are rounded to two decimal places; source values remain unchanged. Unavailable differences have a reason. A difference is not a driver score or a vehicle-health conclusion.
error: The comparison-day request did not complete.
brief: Readable day brief and contributing records
noTrips: No trip records are present in this loaded report selection.
exportHint: The JSON uses the displayed report values, source identity, periods, completion, raw units, brief and contributing trip records. Choose whether to include the loaded comparison day.
coordinatesHint: Coordinates are excluded by default. This option adds only endpoint coordinates already present in the chosen report selections.
